page: Microsoft Azure B16s_v2 is a burstable virtual machine belonging to the Bsv2 server family, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8370C processor operating at 2.8 GHz. The configuration includes 16 vCPUs mapped to 8 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, providing 2 threads per core. The processor is equipped with 48 KB L1D cache, 1 MB L2 cache, and 48 MB L3 cache, alongside support for advanced instruction sets such as AVX-512 and cryptography acceleration via AES and SHA_NI. The instance is provisioned with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a balanced 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, but it is Premium Storage capable for external disk attachments.

In benchmark evaluations, the B16s_v2 demonstrates average tier performance across compute and memory workloads. The stress-ng single-core CPU performance is measured at 1899.28, while multi-core execution reaches 15526.19. Memory bandwidth testing shows a read-only small block cached speed of 839.5 GB/sec, which drops to 97.68 GB/sec for large uncached blocks, and a write speed of 52.68 GB/sec. Under Geekbench testing, the server achieves a single-core score of 1645.0 and a multi-core score of 9893.0, with software compilation scoring 15152.0. Database operations via Passmark score 7997.98, and Redis SET operations reach 15.86 million operations per second. For lightweight machine learning tasks, the server processes 1070.05 tokens per second for prompt processing on a small 135M LLM model, decreasing to 35.06 tokens per second on a medium 7B model.

The burstable CPU allocation model of the B16s_v2 provides a cost-efficient profile for workloads that experience variable or intermittent utilization. By allowing the CPU to burst above its baseline performance when needed, it avoids the higher cost associated with continuously provisioned compute resources. This resource density and burst capability make the server suitable for development environments, build servers, low-to-medium traffic web servers, and database operations that do not require sustained maximum CPU throughput.
description: Microsoft Azure B16s_v2 is a burstable virtual machine from the Bsv2 family, built on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8370C x86_64 processor running at 2.8 GHz, configured with 16 vCPUs across 8 physical cores and 64.0 GB of RAM. The server lacks local storage and dedicated GPUs but supports Premium Storage. Benchmark results place its performance in the average tier, with a Geekbench multi-core score of 9893.0 and a Passmark CPU score of 21253.65. It handles Redis SET operations at 15.86 million operations per second and static web serving at 21.75 GB/sec. Due to its burstable CPU allocation, the B16s_v2 offers a cost-effective solution for workloads with variable resource demands, such as development environments, code compilation, and light database or web serving tasks.
